reason: B more substantively extends prior work by testing whether engineered FCC/BCC interphase coherency and morphology translate a known glide-barrier effect into high-temperature creep resistance, with a direct treated-versus-control experiment. A largely restates the cited single-phase creep study and incorrectly treats dynamic-recrystallization grain refinement as unambiguously creep-strengthening despite evidence that it can accelerate grain-boundary sliding.
